title: Save up to 40% on Hunt wheels this Black Friday
content:

Save up to 40% on Hunt wheels this Black Friday

Black Friday month is finally here. It’s the best time to buy your Christmas presents or just treat yourself, and this year the best savings have come early, with Hunt offering big savings on its popular road, gravel and mountain bike wheels.

Wheels are the most meaningful upgrade you can make to your bike without getting a whole new one, so with savings of up to 40% on wheels across the Hunt range – from more affordable wheelsets to race-ready rims – there has never been a better time to upgrade.

Here are the deals that Hunt is offering for Black Friday 2026 – don’t dilly-dally, they’ll be popular.

Hunt 34_34 Aerodynamicist Carbon Disc wheels

Was £1,149, now £861.75

  • Weight: 1,264g
  • RIm depth: 34.5mm
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 28.4mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 28-30mm, compliant with 25-50mm

There are three sets of Aerodynamicist road racing wheels in Hunt’s Black Friday sale, all with 25% off, so you can take your pick of which rim depth is right for you. The Aerodynamicist range, as the name suggests, is made for speed, having been put through wind-tunnel and CFD testing to save every watt possible.

The 34_34 wheels – with 34.5mm deep rims – are lighter than their competitors at 1,264g, and among the most aero, with Pillar Wing 20 Elliptical Aero stainless steel spokes as well as wide, front and rear specific rim profiles. They have a 22mm internal rim width and have been optimised to work best with 28-30mm tyres but can support 25-50mm.

They feature the H_Ratchet freehub system, which has a smooth, quick and reliable 9° engagement, a reinforced H_Ceramik coating to protect against cassette damage, chromium steel Enduro ABEC 5 bearings for extra longevity and low rolling resistance, plus a CNC machined alloy body and aluminium axle to provide increased stiffness.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£861.75)

Hunt 44_46 Aerodynamicist Carbon Disc wheels

Was £1,179, now £884.25

  • Weight: 1,346g
  • RIm depth: 44.5mm front, 46mm rear
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 31mm front, 30mm rear
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 28-30mm, compliant with 25-50mm

The Hunt 44_46 Aerodynamicist wheels have a 44.5m deep rim up front and a 46mm rim at the back, which brings its total system weight to 1,346g.

They feature all the same performance and durability features as the 34_34 wheels, and with that extra rim depth they’re both lighter and more aerodynamic than their competitors in all wind conditions.

The 44_46 wheels have also been made with H_Cyclo Technology, which uses fully recyclable thermoset epoxy resin, allowing the carbon fibre and resin components to be separated and re-used when the wheels’ lifespan is over.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£884.25)

Hunt 54_58 Aerodynamicist Carbon Disc wheels

Was £1,199, now £899.25

  • Weight: 1,468g
  • RIm depth: 54.5mm front, 58mm rear
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 31.7mm front, 30mm rear
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 28-30mm, compliant with 25-50mm

The most aero of the lot are these 54_58 Aerodynamicists, which, with 54.5mm front and 58mm rear rim depths, have a total weight of 1,468g – far below the competition, while being consistently better in aero testing too.

They have all the performance tech as the 54_58 wheels, including the H_Cyclo Technology to make them recyclable once you’re done riding them.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£899.25)

Hunt 30 Carbon Disc wheels

Was £849, now £594.30

  • Weight: 1,408g
  • RIm depth: 30mm
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 30mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 25-35mm, compliant with 25-50mm

Hunt’s Carbon Disc wheel range are do-it-all wheelsets that bring Hunt’s high-performance wheel tech to more affordable prices, and with 30% off this Black Friday, the value is better than ever, with these 40 Carbon Disc wheels dipping below £600.

Built to perform on the road, gravel and even in cyclocross, they have light and wide hooked rims alongside H_Ratchet 36T SGL hubs, which have a fast 10° engagement angle, and are reliable, easy-to-service and long-lasting, with increased engagement surface area improving power transfer and adding longevity. The freehub body has been coated with H_Ceramik for extra durability and protection from the cassette, and precision stainless steel cartridge bearings are used with proprietary waterproof grease for getting through the worse weather conditions.

The handbuilt wheels use top tier Pillar PSR triple butted J-bend spokes, with narrow gauge spokes on the front wheel for compliance and slightly thicker gauge spokes at the back for extra power transfer, and the rims have 3k reinforcement at spoke holes for further improved durability.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£594.30)

Hunt 40 Carbon Disc wheels

Was £879, now £615.30

  • Weight: 1,433g
  • RIm depth: 40mm
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 30mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 25-35mm, compliant with 25-55mm

Like the 30 Carbon Discs, the 40 Carbon Discs are built for a range of riding, balancing durability with performance features, and this wheelset adds 10mm depth with only 25g added on from the 30mm model. At just £20 more at Black Friday prices, it’s a no-brainer.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£615.30)

Hunt 50 Carbon Disc wheels

Was £899, now £629.30

  • Weight: 1,464g
  • RIm depth: 50mm
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 30mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 25-35mm, compliant with 25-50mm

Add another 10mm rim depth and 31g total weight and you get the most aero of this range in the Hunt 50 Carbon Disc wheels.

Despite their low price, in aerodynamics terms the 50 Carbon Discs only give up four watts compared to the most aerodynamic wheels in this market, and with the versatility to take them riding road, crits and gravel races, it’s a steal at less than £630 for those looking for performance gains.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£629.30)

Hunt 50 Carbon Wide Aero wheels

Was £999, now £699.30

  • Weight: 1,537g
  • RIm depth: 50mm
  • Internal rim width: 19mm
  • External rim width: 27mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 25-28mm, compliant with 23-40mm

Don’t fret, rim brake users, there are deals for you too, Hunt’s 50 Carbon Wide Aero wheels are 30% off, bringing real rim brake performance down to just below £700.

The 50mm deep carbon rims have an aero-rounded profile to bring improved handling as well as reduced drag, and feature Griptec brake tracks for top braking performance in all conditions.

Alongside that, the wheels have butted blade aero spokes in Pillar’s top-of-the-range Re-enforcement PSR XTRA, which are lighter, can maintain tensions longer and add fatigue resistance, and super-lightweight Race Season Sprint hubs with 7.5° engagement angle for instant acceleration.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£699.30)

Hunt 4 Season All-Road Disc wheels

Was £449, now £269.40

  • Weight: 1,680g
  • RIm depth: 25mm
  • Internal rim width: 22mm
  • External rim width: 26mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 25-35mm, compliant with 25-50mm

With a whopping 40% off, the most affordable wheelset in Hunt’s 2026 Black Friday sale is the 4 Season All-Road Discs, just in time for winter.

These aluminium wheels are built to thrive over a variety of surfaces and in all weather conditions, with a wider asymmetric rim profile for added durability and compatibility with wider tyres, plus Hunt’s H_Ratchet SGL hub, which is also on the Carbon Disc wheels, for more durability and protection in bad weather.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£269.40)

Hunt Race Aero Wide wheels

Was £549, now £329.40

  • Weight: 1,496g
  • RIm depth: 31mm
  • Internal rim width: 19mm
  • External rim width: 24mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 25-28mm, compliant with 23-45mm

At full price, the Race Aero Wide offer among the best value wheels on the market for rim brake users looking for a real performance upgrade on a budget.

Their 24mm external rim width allows for optimum use with 25-28mm tyres but compatibility up to 45mm to help with cornering and overall comfort compared to many similar priced wheels.

Hunt’s HFR Alloy+ rims have a higher fatigue resistance than 6061-T6 aluminium, and the Hunt Race Straight-Pull hubs have a 10° RapidEngage 4-pawl freehub for quick and efficient power transfer, with H_Ceramik coating adding durability too.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£329.40)

Hunt 40 Carbon Gravel Race wheels

Was £1,199, now £839.30

  • Weight: 1,431g
  • RIm depth: 40mm
  • Internal rim width: 25mm
  • External rim width: 30mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 35-50mm, compliant with 29-60mm

Into the gravel bike wheels section of Hunt’s Black Friday deals now and you can save 30% on the 40 Carbon Gravel Race wheelset, which has been designed for modern gravel racing, with its light weight, responsiveness and versatility.

The 40mm deep hookless rims help with aerodynamics, rapid acceleration and durability, and they’re paired with the H_Ratchet 40T DBL hubs, which have 9° engagement and 40 teeth, which engage simultaneously to handle high torque.

Like the high end road wheels, they’re made with H_Cyclo fully recyclable thermoset epoxy resin tech that allows the rims to be recycled after use.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£839.30)

Hunt 35 Carbon Gravel wheels

Was £899, now £629.30

  • Weight: 1,459g
  • RIm depth: 35mm
  • Internal rim width: 25mm
  • External rim width: 30mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 40mm, compliant with 29-64mm

The Hunt 35 Carbon Gravel wheels are on offer for just £629.30 for Black Friday, so if you or your loved one are sizing up a race, event or adventure in 2027, it’s an ideal time to upgrade.

Their most recent update switched to a higher strength carbon layup, 25mm internal rim width and a new Hunt H_Ratchet 36T SGL hub, which has been designed for durability as well as high torque loads.

For even more durability they have an asymmetric rim profile as well as Pillar PSR reinforced spokes.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£629.30)

Hunt 4 Season Gravel wheels

Was £549, now £329.40

  • Weight: 1,459g
  • RIm depth: 35mm
  • Internal rim width: 25mm
  • External rim width: 30mm
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 40mm, compliant with 29-64mm

For the toughest winter gravel adventures, look no further than Hunt’s 4 Season Gravel wheels, which are down a huge 40% for Black Friday.

Components have been build for durability and reliability, including high-strength 6066-T6 aluminium rims, plus the brand’s latest H_Ratchet drive hub system, which has four season double-lip bearing shielding for protection from the elements. They also feature an oversized front hub shell to fit in larger bearings as well as Pillar triple-butted PSR spokes, which use corrosion-resistant, self-lubricating brass nipples for extra reliability.

The 25mm internal rim width allows for compatibility with a massive range of tyres, meaning any adventure is in its wheelhouse.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£329.40)

Hunt Proven Carbon Race XC MTB 29 wheels

Was £1,199, now £839.30

  • Weight: 1,469g
  • Internal rim width: 30mm
  • Size: 29in
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 2.25-2.4in, compliant with 2.0-2.6in

As well as road and gravel options, two of Hunt’s mountain bike wheels are also included in its 2026 Black Friday sale, with 30% off its Proven Carbon Race XC MTB 29 wheelset.

Built to balance lightweight performance with everyday dependability, the carbon rims have been fitted to RapidEngage hubs and Pillar triple-butted spokes, which keep it feeling both fast and stable, plus double-sealed Revo bearings, which protect against contamination while also offering smooth rolling performance.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£839.30)

Hunt Trail Wide MTB 29 wheels

Was £499, now £299.40

  • Weight: 1,831g
  • Internal rim width: 30mm
  • Size: 29in
  • Recommended tyre width: Optimised for 2.4-2.6in, compliant with 2.25-2.8in

The Trail Wide MTB 29 wheels are made to meet the demands of modern riders, with its most recent update adding a new 30mm internal rim profile as well as new hubs and configurations of the triple butted Pillar spokes, which Hunt says provides 20% more impact resistance.

They feature durable bearings and RapidEngage hubs with a 5° engagement angle for rapid power transfer, and they’re a whopping 40% off for Black Friday, so you’ll need that speed to grab the deal before they’re gone.

  • Buy now from Hunt (£299.40)
